Canonical miRNA Biogenesis Cascade & Nested Gene Tiers

1 · Nucleus
Microprocessor
DROSHA + DGCR8 crop pri-miRNAs into ~70-nt pre-miRNAs (9ASM).
2 · Pore
Nuclear Export
XPO5 exports 2-nt 3′-overhang hairpins with RanGTP (3A6P).
3 · Cytoplasm
5p / 3p Dicing
DICER1 + TARBP2 / PRKRA cleave 5p (IIIb) & 3p (IIIa) strands (7XW2).
4 · RISC
Argonaute Slicing
AGO2 (8q24.3 Slicer) & 1p34.3 AGO1/3/4 guide target silencing (4W5N).
5 · Regulation
Let-7 & Accessories
LIN28A/B block let-7; SMAD2/4 & TP53 modulate pri-miRNAs.
TierGenesIncluded SymbolsScope
Core-1010DROSHA, DGCR8, XPO5, DICER1, TARBP2, PRKRA, AGO1–4Dedicated maturation & RISC machinery (collapses 1p34.3).
Extended-1212Core-10 + LIN28A, LIN28BAdds direct oncofetal let-7 blockade.
Panel-1414Extended-12 + SMAD2, SMAD4Adds 18q21.1 SMAD Microprocessor cofactors.
All-1515Panel-14 + TP53Gene/3D comparison only (excluded from pathway union).

    About the Resource
    
        
    miRBioGenAtlas (v2.0.2)
    
        
    
          miRBioGenAtlas is an open-access, multi-consortium reference of the human microRNA biogenesis machinery integrating somatic coding mutations, chromosome-arm-deconfounded copy-number alterations, 213,940-variant 3D structural and language-model saturation scores, and endogenous mature 5p:3p small-RNA readouts across 21,140 sequenced human tumours. All 3D side-chain modelling and queries execute locally in your browser with zero tracking or data upload.
        
    

        
    
          
    
            
    Reproducible by Design
    
            
    Built deterministically from 46 SHA-256-verified raw snapshots with 7 automated integrity tests.
    
          
    
          
    
            
    Open Dual Licensing
    
            
    Derived tables & figures: CC BY 4.0 · Pipeline, CLI & 3D web explorer: MIT License.
    
          
    
          
    
            
    Instant CLI & Bulk Data
    
            
    41 CSV/CSV.GZ tables on Zenodo plus offline Python CLI: query_variant.py DICER1 E1705K.
